description: §6.15: `onclick=` calling a writer, a handler block that writes, and a two-way `bind:value` are not initializers or render positions — no E-VALUE-WRITES-STATE / E-VALUE-WRITE-UNPROVEN.
rationale: §6.15: "Event-handler attribute values, `bind:` bindings, function bodies (judged at their call sites), lifecycle element bodies, engine `effect=` / `<onTransition>` bodies and body-top statement lists are not value positions." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S449 "⭐⭐ RULED — \"your recs.\" on the S449 eight-question queue" — item 3: "Initializers / derived formulas / markup interpolations may NOT write reactive state = (a) — a compile error everywhere, directly or through a called function".
